# coolify_integration_token (Resource)

Manages a Coolify integration token for Cloudflare, Doppler, Infisical, or Vault. Requires Coolify >= v4.6.0. Create checks the secret with that provider. The secret and metadata are not returned on read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_integration_token" "cloudflare" {
  name                 = "cloudflare-dns"
  integration_provider = "cloudflare"
  token                = "change-me-in-production"

  # Cloudflare defaults to ["dns"] when capabilities is omitted.
  capabilities = ["dns"]
}

resource "coolify_integration_token" "vault" {
  name                 = "vault"
  integration_provider = "vault"
  token                = "change-me-in-production"
  metadata_base_url    = "https://vault.example.com"
  metadata_namespace   = "admin"
  metadata_timeout     = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_provider` (String) Integration provider: `cloudflare`, `doppler`, `infisical`, or `vault`. Sent as the API field `provider`. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the integration token. At most 255 characters.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Provider secret. Coolify never returns it. After import, set it again before the next change that checks the secret. Doppler secrets must start with `dp.st.` or `dp.sa.`.

### Optional

- `automatic_dns` (Boolean) Cloudflare only. Create DNS records when a domain is added. Coolify's default is true. Other providers reject this attribute.
- `capabilities` (List of String) What the token may do. Cloudflare: `dns` and `tunnel` (`tunnel` also needs `dns`). Doppler, Infisical, and Vault: `secrets`. Omit this to let Coolify use `dns` for Cloudflare and `secrets` for the others.
- `metadata_base_url` (String, Sensitive) Secret-manager API URL. Required for Infisical and Vault. Forbidden for Cloudflare. Not returned on read.
- `metadata_client_id` (String) Infisical client id. Required for Infisical. Forbidden for Cloudflare. Not returned on read.
- `metadata_namespace` (String) Vault namespace. Forbidden for Cloudflare. Not returned on read. Remove the attribute to clear the stored namespace.
- `metadata_timeout` (Number) Secret-manager request timeout in seconds (1-300). Forbidden for Cloudflare. Not returned on read. Remove the attribute to clear the stored timeout.
- `proxied_dns` (Boolean) Cloudflare only. Create new DNS records proxied (orange cloud). Coolify's default is false. Other providers reject this attribute.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When Coolify created the token.
- `dns_zones_count` (Number) Number of Cloudflare DNS zones Coolify could read. Computed. Empty for other providers.
- `updated_at` (String) When Coolify last updated the token.
- `uuid` (String) Integration token UUID.
- `zones_synced_at` (String) When Cloudflare zones were last read. Computed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coolify_integration_token.cloudflare 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
